title: Kelly T NDE 4854
content: I grabbed a pillow and blanket, and fell as asleep on my mother's lap on a Sunday afternoon as I wasn't feeling well. I then remember seeing a bright light and suddenly being up in the sky just above my parents' apartment building. I didn't feel alone. I felt the presence of an angelic light being who was with me to my right. It felt very peaceful! We hovered in the sky watching my father in sheer panic carrying my lifeless body out of the apartment building with my mother and little brother following. I saw my father place my body in the backseat of the car and saw them rush to the hospital. I then remember hearing my family's voices (parents, aunts, uncles) all calling out my name, asking me to wake up. I sensed the being that was with me giving me the okay to return to my body. I then remember darkness, hearing their voices a little louder, and then waking up in a hospital bed with my family surrounding me in tears. I woke up in complete peace, turned to my mom and said, 'Mommy! I saw an angel!' After that, I remember the hospital staff placing me into an ambulance to transfer me to a specialized children's hospital. When my dad rushed me into the emergency room, the doctors told him that even if I lived; I would live the rest of my life mentally challenged (as that's what happened with one of my friend's sister). I was very blessed and very lucky to survive and to return 'normally.' Granted, it killed a lot of my brain cells and learning in school became very difficult for me. After years of healthful living, I'm more intelligent than most girls my age, now own my own company in Beverly Hills and model! After this NDE, I became a very spiritual little girl! I would often wander off into the woods to spend time alone in nature, build birdhouses for birds using grass and twigs, sang songs, completely clicked with the music of Enigma (pretty deep for a seven year old) and felt as though I had the soul of a Native American Indian! My mom had me walk in a procession within that year (we were Catholic) to give thanks to God for my life. I began asking her questions like, 'Who's God? Why are we here? Who was that angel that I saw? When's the beginning and end of time?' I developed a strange fascination for the beginnings, ends, and truths of things. Going to church didn't fulfill my spiritual answers and needs. At seven years old, I had no choice. Things have changed quite drastically over the past three years when I experienced my spiritual reawakening and have come to more and more into my spirituality and learning about my NDE. It's truly amazing and I'm quite grateful for the experience!!! It also helped love, light-filled place, and me to be okay with death as, when we 'die,' our souls continue in a very peaceful! According to my psychic here in Beverly Hills, she stated that this happened because at the time of my mother's pregnancy with me, things were bad in her life - so bad that her negative energies and emotional blocks, blocked the progress of my soul. I was born a very sad little girl crying constantly! My father had to drive me around in his car for almost two hours every night in order to get me to fall asleep. Even up until the NDE, I was a very sad little girl who cried all the time, didn't talk to anyone in school, and felt very lonely. Because of my mother's emotional block which blocked the progress of my soul's development; she stated that a gift wasn't passed through while I was in my mother's stomach. She said that I needed to 'die' in order to obtain these gifts from the other side in order to complete the development of my soul with what I needed to succeed in this life cycle. Those gifts have made me so successful today doing what I love to do! I needed to be reborn. (She actually stated that the next time I talk about this with anyone that I should refer to it as my rebirth rather than a near-death experience.)

arrival.other_being_detail: Presence of an 'angelic light being' to her right while hovering above the apartment building.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She 'sensed the being... giving me the okay to return,' then experienced 'darkness,' heard voices louder, and woke in a hospital bed.

person_demographics.occupation: Owns her own company in Beverly Hills and is a model (reported later in life).

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Bright light and immediate OBE above the apartment building; no tunnel or life review; then return after sensing permission from the angelic being.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Aftereffects narrative includes a later 'psychic' interpretation that she needed to 'die' to obtain 'gifts' and be 'reborn,' but this is presented as the psychic's explanation rather than part of the NDE scene itself.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Mommy! I saw an angel!”; “I needed to be reborn.”
